prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic portrait of a young Black man sitting on a patterned, bohemian-style couch. He wears a bright red shirt and a pair of futuristic white FPV (first-person view) drone goggles with glowing red and blue LED lights, the brand "Fat Shark" visible on the side. The goggles have a prominent antenna extending forward, adding a sense of high-tech immersion. The subject’s face is partially obscured by the goggles, but his relaxed posture and slight downward gaze suggest deep concentration or engagement with a virtual experience. The background is softly out of focus, featuring a richly colored, paisley-patterned fabric that adds warmth and texture to the scene. The lighting is gentle and ambient, casting a soft glow that enhances the intimate, contemplative mood. The overall style is naturalistic with a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the subject and his unique eyewear, evoking a sense of curiosity and modern digital culture.
